==Ingredients==
* 3 large [[cookbook:banana|bananas]] or 4 medium bananas, [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] granulated [[Cookbook:sugar|sugar]]
* ⅓ cup all purpose [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]] or 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:salt|salt]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Egg yolk|egg yolks]], slightly beaten
* 2 Tbsp [[Cookbook:butter|butter]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Vanilla Extract|vanilla extract]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. 9-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (23 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) baked [[Cookbook:Flaky Pie Crust|pastry shell]]
* [[Cookbook:meringue|Meringue]] made from the leftover [[cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]] (optional)

==Procedure==
# Combine sugar, cornstarch, and salt in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].  
# Add milk gradually.
# Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat until bubbly.  
# Cook and stir an additional 2 minutes and remove from burner.
# Stir small amount of hot mixture into egg yolks, then immediately add egg yolk mixture to hot mixture and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. 
# Remove from heat.
# Add butter and vanilla and stir until smooth.
# Slice bananas into the cooled baked pastry shell.
# Top with pudding mixture and spread meringue (if desired) on top of the pie.  
# [[cookbook:Bake|Bake]] at 350°F (175°C) for 12–15 minutes.  
# Cool before serving.

== Notes, tips, and variations == 
* Fresh [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|whipped cream]] can be substituted for meringue after the pie is baked.

== References ==
* Based on [http://www-2.cs.cmu.edu/~mjw/recipes/pie/sweet/ban-crm-pie.html Recipe Archive: Banana Cream Pie July 1993]
